sources: datasheets/ASM2464PD-PDX-PCB-Guideline-Mid-loss-R1.0.pdf pages 5-6: power W:S 15:8 mil, short connections, L3/L4 power and L2/L5 ground
datasheets/ASM2464PDX_TI_R03.pdf sheet 3: VCCH bypass bank and R4/C7/C8 analog feed
datasheets/TPS389001DSET.pdf section 11: low-impedance VDD bypass and no added CT capacitance
vcchSource: All four main ATX 3.3 V contacts; includes flash, pull-ups, monitor supply, programming power and all three slot-switch source pads
vcca33Source: Existing R_VCCA33_4 0 ohm link from VCCH; retains a distinct analog net

bridgeCurrentPlanning.basis: User accepted a combined 100 mA bridge allowance. The split between VCCH and VCCA33 is unknown. This is a project assumption, not an ASMedia maximum. Flash, pull-ups, supervisor, programming power and slot loads require separate budgets.

contactScope: Short BGA and component escapes use pad-compatible widths where the fixed pad pitch prevents the general 15:8 mil geometry. Fabrication checks apply throughout. These are local contacts to the broad inner distribution regions.
groundRoutingChanges: D4, D5, F4, K2 and L2 use adjacent existing return vias. F8 and H8 retain the former shared inner ground via sites. Existing signal and buck copper stays fixed.

supervisorSense.note: Low-current measurement wiring, not a power-distribution branch. The ASMedia 15:8 mil power-feed guidance remains applied to the supply distribution. Existing 16.2 kOhm / 10 kOhm divider, VDD bypass, CT no-connect and all assembled placements remain unchanged.

qualification.note: The accepted bridge-only allowance is 100 mA combined for VCCH and VCCA33. It does not establish a PDX current maximum. Earlier 50 mA results do not validate this allowance. Voltage at the package, startup, transient response, thermal behavior and final manufacturer acceptance remain open. The existing VCCL/VDD 3 A voltage-drop screen and its 8 mV criterion remain unchanged.
